description: Town/city halls, theatres, observatories, market halls, courthouses and concert halls built 1500-1899 (P571 or P1619), coords + enwiki, sl>=2.
where: ?item wdt:P625 ?hm_co . { ?item wdt:P571 ?hm_inc } UNION { ?item wdt:P1619 ?hm_inc } FILTER(YEAR(?hm_inc) >= 1500 && YEAR(?hm_inc) < 1900)
